_comment: Recordings gallery for the /artwork/ page. Items with draft:true are admin-only visible. Items with src:'/captures/recordings/...' play from local file; once youtube_id is populated, the page uses a YouTube embed instead. Proposed items (proposed:true) don't have files yet — they're AppC pitch suggestions waiting for the autoplay-capture pipeline. On Drew approval, src gets uploaded to YouTube (Unlisted), youtube_id is filled in, draft flips to false.

recordings.title: Cloud shadows over Laria
recordings.description: 30-second loop showing the parallax cloud shadows passing over hill props in Laria-MainSquare. Calm atmosphere reel — no combat, just the visual feature.

recordings.description: Full combat encounter from entry to victory. Showcases combat system, action overlay, and damage queue.
